qualification: Operational copies/indexes are allowed only as explicitly nonsemantic hash-verified aliases; mismatch fails closed and copies may be regenerated/removed without information loss.

qualification: Do not collapse this with upstream empirical field validity. Comparator/source/field owners decide their own applicability/failure semantics. A V3 use/metabolism change may require re-binding without field recomputation; an objective fact/source/time change may require upstream requery under governed authority. qualification: Empirical meanings stay at earliest owners: ACTOR_PROPERTY_MISSING/NO_COMPARATOR/AMBIGUOUS/TEMPORAL_NONCOMPARABLE are comparator-owned; SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE/TARGET_UNAVAILABLE/ZERO_SUPPORT/LOW_SUPPORT/field uncertainty/disagreement are field/source-owned. V3-specific negatives concern intake applicability such as stale/refresh-required, metabolism authority missing or input-use denied. Exact names remain close-read work.

r02_holding: PSEPF/use through V3 cannot directly assign actor state and same upstream priors need not yield same life
surviving_rule: Same PSEPF plus same ResolvedStructuralContext must remain compatible with divergent lawful developed states when post-branch V3 encounters/relationships/events/history differ.
qualification: Divergence proof must hold relevant upstream inputs and starting objective comparator facts fixed and attribute differences to V3-owned causal history and explicitly governed randomness, not hidden field mutation.

r02_holding: PSEPF, comparator/source geometry and ResolvedStructuralContext are not direct V2/application persona/voice/belief/expression authority
surviving_rule: V2/application may not directly semantically dereference PSEPF, comparator receipts, source disagreement or ResolvedStructuralContext to personalize actor voice/persona/belief/expression.
qualification: This prohibition does not bar V2 from rendering empirical/structural subject matter after V3 lawfully generated actor-accessible knowledge/belief through actual causal history. Opaque audit refs confer no expression semantics.
